quiz.name: 2027 Equities - Module 2 Equity Jurisdictions, Classes, and the Voting Process

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod2-Q1
entry.itemBody: Which type of DR would MSUMC most likely own?

choices.itemBody: C. Either type of DR Feedback Choice B is correct. MSUMC would prefer to own sponsored DRs because the holder of sponsored receipts retains shareholder voting rights. Choices A and C are incorrect because the depository bank retains the voting rights on the company’s shares in an unsponsored DR.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod2-Q2
entry.itemBody: Which one of the following statements provides the most likely reason why MSUMC would place a ban on owning shares of companies with dual class structures?

choices.itemBody: A. Dual class structures typically provide multiple classes of traded shares with unequal voting rights.
B. Dual class structures typically provide unequal cash flow rights to shareholders.

C. Dual class structures typically provide one class of untraded shares with superior voting rights to those of traded shares. Feedback Correct Answer: C. Dual class structures typically provide one class of untraded shares with superior voting rights to those of traded shares.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod2-Q3
entry.itemBody: Which one of the following conditions would most likely be necessary for MSUMC to vote “yes” on a shareholder proposal that would cause the board to encroach on day-to-day management?

choices.itemBody: A. Management presents arguments in the proxy statement that the risk mitigation of the proposal is not material.
B. Management is already working on the issue underlying the proposal.

C. Management following the proposal would materially improve firm value Feedback Choice C is correct. In general, a shareholder proposal that, if passed, would cause the board to encroach on management’s day-to-day operations is not appropriate unless the actions would have material and positive effects on firm value and/or risk mitigation. Choice A is incorrect because MSUMC is unlikely to base their vote on management’s arguments. Choice B is incorrect as this is typically likely to result in a “no” vote by MSUMC.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod2-Q4
entry.itemBody: Which of the following are typically correct about management and shareholder proposals?

choices.itemBody: A. Both proposal types are shown in the company’s proxy statement.
B. Shareholder proposals are binding if passed.

C. Shareholder proposals are frequently passed Feedback Choice A is correct. A company’s proxy statement includes both management and shareholder proposals, including the company’s voting recommendations to shareholders along with the rationales for the recommendations. Choice B is incorrect because shareholder proposals, if passed, are typically not binding on the company. Choice C is incorrect because shareholder proposals are not frequently passed.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod2-Q5
entry.itemBody: The voting rights of an unsponsored depository receipt (DR) belong to the:

choices.itemBody: B. direct owners of the foreign common shares.
C. foreign company whose shares are held by the depository. Feedback: A is correct. In the case of unsponsored DRs, the depository bank, not the investors in the DR, retains the voting rights.
